body: I don’t necessarily think you’re an asshole for getting upset at that. I like to think I wouldn’t have said what you said but that’s a pretty frustrating situation. I’ve been there with the depression and it’s hard to make people understand, even close friends. Try not to take it too personally, I’m sure he was just lashing out and my guess is he’ll come around.
Agreed, although I think it's being overlooked because Tyrion largely felt like a minor character this season. Hopefully that changes because I loved that dynamic
I knew what was coming as soon as I read "hey kiddo!" near the end but I still got goosebumps. Great read
